newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine suggests oil transport link to Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine suggests oil transport link to Kazakhstan.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma asked Kazakhstan on Monday to expand energy transport ties between the two countries by sending Central Asian oil and gas to Europe via Ukraine.

A Kuchma spokesman said the president had suggested to Kazakh Foreign Affairs Minister Kazimzhomart Tokayev during a recent visit that Kazakhstan send some its oil across the Caspian Sea to the Azeri port of Baku.
The oil would then go by existing pipeline across Azerbaijan to Georgia's Black Sea port of Poti.
From there, it would go by ferry or tanker to Ukraine's Odessa outlet, where there is an existing oil terminal, and on to Ukraine's Druzhba pipeline to Eastern and Central Europe.
No volumes or start dates were mentioned.
Kazakhstan is eager to widen its oil export opportunities, which are limited until a planned, multi-billion dollar pipeline is built.
